topLevel: the analysis reads the roles, the slots and the sentences of the protocol, and refuses a protocol it does not understand
the median is the protocol's (the mean of the two middle values), not the nearest rank of the oracle, and the idle reference is the median of the half-sums
the module reproduces the protocol's fixed interval and its known answer, with the parameters read from the protocol
the four categories, the non-inferior flag beside them, and H1 and H2 as estimates with no category
the margin is the larger of 10% of B's median and the floor of 0.5 ms: the same difference is a cost under the floor and neutral under 10%
a hand-checkable campaign: arms with no spread give point intervals and the differences of the medians
the report recomputes from its own per-run values: the intervals and the p-values are the bootstrap of the right arms in the right order
the Holm guard downgrades a category whose claim does not stand in the family of four windows, and shows the unadjusted one beside it
the axes: the verdict of C against B with the outcome's own margin, the deterministic package size and the single observation of the cost of change
FPS without a limit: higher is better, a gain excludes zero, and the axis is N/A when the vsync does not read DISABLED
the descriptive outcomes report medians, interquartile ranges and intervals with no category, and leave the warm-up out
the absolute budgets: met when at most the frozen value, exceeded otherwise, and N/A for the stress window the freeze left N/A
when arm B is not ready the report is A against C: H1 only, no category for H3 and no gain claimed
the parameters are read from the protocol when the script runs: a changed protocol changes the interval, the margin and the load limit
the report has the sections of the protocol in order, the frozen values and the hash of the protocol, and takes its words from the campaign
the same campaign gives the same report byte for byte, and the seed of the protocol is in it
the command line writes the report of a campaign file, checks its format and refuses a bad one
the example report of the evidence record is the exact output of the script for the synthetic campaign regenerated with the same seed, by the commands of its README
the protocol's test imports the functions from the modules, and the tests are part of the contracts
a load above the limit is rejected with its reading and redone in the same slot, and the rejected attempt does not count
an execution that did not draw or was not paced in the presented lane is rejected with the reason, and the same data in the unlimited lane is not
an incomplete window or idle window, a wrong hash, a wrong seed or a Debug build, an error and a parity mismatch are each rejected with their rule
the fourth attempt, or three rejected ones, stop the campaign and no statistic is produced
a repeat of the other game in one arm stops the campaign, in either lane, and an instrument that did not pass counts nothing
the order of the executions: slots follow the protocol's sequence, the planned and accepted counts balance by position, and an arm with too few executions is incomplete
attempts that contradict one another, or data that are not in the format, are refused and not analysed
the protocol has every required field with its type, and the validator is not vacuous
the three arms, the three hypotheses and the four windows are the ones decided
the secondary outcomes are the ones decided, and each axis with a verdict carries its margin
only the thresholds can be frozen, each with a rule and a source, and both fields move together
the pin: the protocol without its freeze fields has the SHA-256 recorded here
an amendment says what changed, why, the text it replaces and that no comparative measurement came before it
arm B's time-box has its length, recorded before arm B starts, and the iPhone's open item follows the NO-GO
a change of the protocol after the pre-registration fails unless it comes with an amendment and a pin
while the comparative executions have not run, an amendment cannot count measurements before it
the categories are exactly gain, neutral, cost and inconclusive, and exclusive and exhaustive for any interval
the margin is the larger of 10% of B's median and 0.5 ms, and the examples land where the research note says
a gain is always better: the interval of an outcome where higher is better is negated, and a gain in FPS excludes zero
Holm over the four windows of H3 stands for the smallest p-values in order and only ever downgrades
the order of the executions is a Latin square repeated, balanced in count and position
the load limit is written and the redo of an execution is bounded
the percentiles, the median, the interquartile range and the bootstrap are defined and reproducible
the research note covers the protocol it reads and quotes its pin and its examples
this test is part of the contracts
